title: console: align the stored-view-row reads to the spec's declared round-trip spellings, and drop the reads nothing writes (objectstack#20456 objectui end, #20051 ruling 甲 stage ii)
body:
Filing gate ③: a ruled task. This is the **objectui end** of objectstack-ai/objectstack#20456, stage (ii) of objectstack-ai/objectstack#20051's ruling 甲 (`5856781584`, batch #227 item 2, maintainer 「开始总监决裁」). Filed by objectstack `domain:spec` seat 4 (`session_01ARcDurZ5j34RdqsGgc4jgH`, seat post objectstack-ai/objectstack#18917) at the ACCEPT of the spec end, as the cross-repo rule requires: spec first, and the consumer card carries `Blocked-by:`. ⛔ Filed bare: routing and grading belong to objectui triage. ⛔ Not a claim.

Blocked-by: objectstack-ai/objectstack#20474

**Acting reader:** the objectui lane seat that dispatches this card. It can be dispatched once objectstack-ai/objectstack#20474 is merged AND the objectstack `.objectui-sha` / published `@objectstack/spec` the console builds against carries `VIEW_CONSOLE_ROUND_TRIP_KEYS`. That symbol is the cross-repo unlock reading.

## What the ruling orders for this end (verbatim)

> …declares each on the stored-overlay wire with its meaning, **and objectui aligns its reads to the declared spellings.**

## The spec end, as accepted (objectstack-ai/objectstack#20474, head `fc5a47d0`, at-tier PASS `5874993923`)

`packages/spec/src/ui/view.zod.ts` declares the six keys the console writes and reads back from a stored view row. The new export `VIEW_CONSOLE_ROUND_TRIP_KEYS` maps each key to its member:

| key | `viewItem` | `listOverlay` | meaning |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| `isDefault` | ✓ | ✓ | the default view in the switcher |
| `isPinned` | ✓ | ✓ | pinned in the switcher (`boolean`) |
| `sortOrder` | ✓ | ✓ | 0-based saved-view position (`int`) |
| `visibility` | ✓ | ✓ | `private` / `team` / `organization` / `public`: **display grouping only, restricts nobody** |
| `columnState` | ✓ | ✓ | column order + widths |
| `_isOverride` | — | ✓ | the settings-overlay marker, `true` only |

The census was read at objectui `dd3f7e1b` (the objectstack pin), by a compiler-API walk with lit and dark controls. It is in the PR body.

## What this end owes (the seat's answers `5874463510` on objectstack-ai/objectstack#20456, and the record)

1. **Read the declared spellings, not the undeclared ones.**
   - The bound object: read `object`, not `objectName`. Every reader already falls back to `object`: `data-objectstack` `index.ts:2698`, `ObjectView.tsx:1802` and `ResourceEditPage.tsx:933` at the pin.
   - The row identity: read `name`, not a top-level `id`. `viewRowId` reads `name` first (`viewIdentity.ts:95`).
   - `filter[].id` / `sort[].id` stay row decorations the spec strips before the parse. The builders already re-mint a missing id (`view-config-utils.ts:159`, `:319`); make sure no reader keys state by a row id across a reload.
   - `exportOptions`: read the object form `{ formats }` that the parse lifts a bare array to (`ObjectGrid.tsx:3888` does). Retire the bare-array tolerance at `ListView.tsx:1783` once rows are stored parsed.
2. **Drop the reads that nothing writes** (the seat's disposition for `allowExport`, answer 3: no producer means no declared spelling):
   - `allowExport` (`ObjectView.tsx:2838-2839`);
   - the eight renderer flags the record found read off the active view and written by no console surface: `wrapHeaders`, `clickIntoRecordDetails`, `addRecordViaForm`, `addDeleteRecordsInline`, `collapseAllByDefault`, `fieldTextColor`, `prefixField` (`app-shell/ObjectView.tsx:2864-2870`, `plugin-view/ObjectView.tsx:2547-2553`) and `editRecordsInline` (`:2805`).

   For each read, measure whether any producer exists, whether that is a stored row or an authored view (the spec's strict view schema refuses all nine). Zero producers ⇒ drop the read. A real producer ⇒ stop and raise it on objectstack-ai/objectstack#20051 as a spec declaration question, ⛔ never a consumer-side tolerance. `showSearch` / `showFilters` / `showSort` already have declared spellings (`userActions.search` / `.filter` / `.sort`); align them.
3. **`listViews` record flatten** (the spec dev's note, verified by the record): `data-objectstack` `index.ts:5466-5472` flattens a ViewItem record to `config` + `name` / `label` / `isDefault` / `_draft`. So `isPinned` / `sortOrder` / `visibility` / `columnState`, written at the record's top level by the pin toggle and the config save, come back only through the `loadViewOverrides` override merge. Align that reader with the declared ViewItem members.

## Not this card

- ⛔ Stage (iv), storing the parsed body, is objectstack's and waits for stages (ii) and (iii). Its prerequisites are recorded on objectstack-ai/objectstack#20051.
- `visibility: 'private'` draws a lock icon and restricts nobody (`ViewTabBar.tsx:442`). The spec now declares it with that meaning. Any access-control reading of it would be a new product decision, not this card.

Dedupe: objectui#4227, #5344 and #6011 (all closed) touch view rows or spellings; none is this alignment.
